letter:
My dearest,
I’ve been trying to find the right words to tell you how much you mean to me, and I keep coming back to the simplest truth: you make my ordinary days feel extraordinary.
I love the way you laugh at your own jokes before you even finish telling them. I love how you always know exactly what to say when I’m having a rough day. Even after all this time, I still get a little thrill when I see your name pop up on my phone.
Thank you for being my favourite person to talk to, my favourite person to be quiet with, and my favourite person to build a life alongside. Every day with you feels like a gift.
I can’t wait for more memories, more inside jokes, more quiet Sunday mornings and loud, happy nights.
Forever yours ♡
scrapbook:
Happy birthday to the one who makes my world brighter. I don’t say it enough, but I’m endlessly grateful for your kindness, your strength, and the way you love me so effortlessly.

Watching you grow, chase your dreams, and stay true to yourself inspires me every day. I hope this new year brings you success, peace, and all the joy you give so freely to others.

Thank you for being exactly who you are. I love you more than words could ever capture. ♡
